name: jev-decision-layer
description: Advisory decision checkpoints for agents: route work to a worker, check a research claim, review task completion, and guard proposed actions. Backed by TypeSafe Jev Choice questions. Returns decisions only and never executes anything.

TYPESAFE_API_KEY.title: TypeSafe API key (secret)
TYPESAFE_API_KEY.description: Secret Bearer key for https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone. Set it in Plugins → Configure; never commit it.
